name: The Nursery-Rhyme Child
effect: Boosting this layer-6 neuron makes the model drop long, structured, helpful answers and talk like a children's storybook or nursery rhyme: simple sentences, sing-song repetition and silly non-sequiturs.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
